context: Request: every M&A matter where a no-shop or exclusivity covenant made it into an executed agreement (executed definitive agreement or standalone executed exclusivity agreement, not an LOI, term sheet or draft), with those agreements. Rubric: twenty matters with proof documents, plus a precision criterion. Errors: 1002-00004 (standalone exclusivity agreement with executed amendments, excluded as a venture financing in all runs), 1006-00006 (executed APA, never opened in T0, which listed sibling 1006-00008), 1037-00006 (T1 called its exclusivity agreement unexecuted), extra matters 1007-00002 (stalking-horse APA, all runs) and 1036-00004 (T2).

divergence: All three runs failed with similar errors at the writing stage. All surfaced every needed matter with scans and file-name searches and opened nearly all of them; all excluded the matter whose covenant sits in a standalone exclusivity agreement with executed amendments (as a financing, or with no reason in T2) and all included a court-supervised sale agreement (T2 also a real-estate purchase agreement). T0's first error came earlier: of the agreements it chose to read it took a sibling matter's and never opened one needed matter. T1 also called one standalone agreement unexecuted. The critic flagged the exclusion specifically only in T0 (ignored); over- and under-inclusion were otherwise flagged only generically or not at all.
